notes.title: 1.2.1 version update!
notes.content: A new game sorting function has been added. Players can press the S key on the keyboard (press the Y key on the Gamepad) to switch the game sorting method on the game selection interface. There are three sorting methods: by recommended scores, by release dates, and by number of plays.

notes.title: "The Legend of the Yan Loong 1+2" will be updated for free in the future!
notes.content:
"The Legend of the Yan Loong 1+2" will be continuously updated for free in the future, and we will continue to add interesting modes that we can think of, such as the AI ​​teammate cooperation mode that will be updated in a while, the teammate mutual fighting mode, and the martial arts hall mode where you can choose enemies and bosses. etc. Our goal is to let everyone feel nostalgic while having new and interesting game content. Thank you for your support!
